patches.name: Bypass Play Store install check (IPTV)
patches.description: Fixes 'Local install check failed due to wrong installer.' by forcing local installer check and license check to pass + disabling paywall activity.

patches.name: Unlock Pro (IPTV)
patches.description: Deactivates subscription_needed gate and forces RevenueCat pro entitlement to active. Works offline, no server check.
